children.text: Per-input conditioning detail, reached from the input sub-tab. #697 slice S5, frame 1 of 4. The stage is a fixed utility, not a chain entry — it cannot be reordered, never enters the chain fingerprint, and its params read in real units (Hz, dB, ratio, ms), which is why the controls are ParamSliders with unit read-outs and not the normalised 0..1 FX knobs. Three sections, each with its own On/Off because 0 = section off in the engine (HPF cutoff 0, hum base 0): high-pass, hum notch (mains base 50/60 + harmonic count, default 4), downward expander (threshold / ratio / release; attack fixed ~5 ms, no look-ahead). Enable and every param are per input, not per lane — siblings capture identical samples. PRINTED INTO THE TAKE reuses the record-red chip verbatim: conditioning sits upstream of capture, so the recorded PCM already embodies it, and the monitor hears exactly what records (WYSIWYG). Zero added latency is a hard design rule (IIR biquads + no-lookahead envelope follower), stated in the footer so the stage is never mistaken for a look-ahead processor.
